🖥 Man Utd vs Roma: Predicted lineups, team news, and Champions League preview

📌 Man Utd vs Roma Champions League preview, featuring predicted lineups, injury updates, kick-off time and key stats ahead of the Old Trafford encounter.

Manchester United host Roma at Old Trafford on Tuesday, 3 November, in Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase, with Michael Carrick's side desperate to end a nine-match winless run across all competitions. United have lost their previous two European fixtures, while Roma arrive having scored at least three goals in four of their last five matches.
​
Both teams have selection concerns ahead of the 8 p.m. GMT kick-off. United are without Marcus Rashford, while Roma must cope with the absences of goalkeeper Mile Svilar and midfielders Manu Koné and Lorenzo Pellegrini. The visitors have collected four points from their opening three Champions League matches, compared with United's three.
​
Manchester United could make changes in midfield and defence following their defeat at Chelsea, with Kobbie Mainoo expected to return to the starting XI.
​
Roma, meanwhile, are likely to retain their three-man defensive system, with Donyell Malen leading the attack and Matias Soulé providing support.
​
Man Utd Predicted Lineup (4-2-3-1)
​
Roma Predicted Lineup (3-4-2-1)
​
Carrick faces several selection decisions following United's 2–0 defeat against Chelsea.
​
Patrick Dorgu has returned to training after a hamstring injury but is not yet ready for competitive action. Marcus Rashford remains sidelined with a hip problem, while Benjamin Šeško, Luke Shaw and Manuel Ugarte are also listed among United's injury concerns.
​
Amad Diallo sustained a knock against Chelsea, although the problem is not expected to keep him out of Tuesday's fixture.
​
Lisandro Martínez is available for the Champions League despite his dismissal at Stamford Bridge. His suspension applies domestically, but his recent performances could prompt Carrick to make a defensive change.
​
Mainoo is expected to return to midfield after appearing as a substitute against Chelsea. Carlos Baleba could make way, with Youri Tielemans retaining his place.
​
Roma have significant absences in goal and midfield.
​
Mile Svilar is expected to remain unavailable until after the international break because of a stress fracture in his fifth toe. Pierluigi Gollini is therefore predicted to start at Old Trafford.
​
Manu Koné and Lorenzo Pellegrini are also unavailable, leaving Bryan Cristante and Marten de Roon as potential midfield partners.
​
Paulo Dybala is another injury concern due to a calf problem. If the Argentine fails to recover, Rodrigo Mora and Matias Soulé could operate behind Donyell Malen.
​
Manchester United and Roma meet on Tuesday, 3 November, at Old Trafford in Manchester.
​
United enter Tuesday's fixture under considerable pressure after extending their winless sequence to nine matches in all competitions.
​
Their recent defeats include a 3–0 home loss to Bournemouth and Saturday's 2–0 defeat at Chelsea.
​
At Stamford Bridge, United competed well during the opening half but were undone by defensive errors. Morgan Rogers opened the scoring before Martínez received two yellow cards in quick succession, with his dismissal contributing to Chelsea's second goal from the penalty spot.
​
United have now lost three consecutive matches and suffered four defeats in their last five outings.
​
Their Champions League campaign has also been difficult. After beating Sabah, Carrick's team lost 2–0 against Atlético Madrid  . . .
